---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for Herbert
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Component

Which component would this feature affect? (e.g., `/mod`, `/nn`, `/rl`, `/bot`)

## Description

A clear and concise description of what you'd like to see added or improved.

## Motivation

Why would this feature be useful? How would it improve Herbert?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working. Include any design sketches, pseudocode,
or architectural notes if helpful.

## Alternatives

Have you considered alternative approaches? Describe any you've thought of.

## Additional Context

Any other context, examples, or related discussions.

## For /mod feature requests

If proposing a new capture metric or field:
- Explain why it would be useful for training models
- Note the performance impact (mod tick overhead)
- If it requires Hypixel-specific parsing, provide example scoreboard/NBT data
